name: skill_creator
description: Design and create a brand-new OADSON skill when no existing skill covers something you've asked for. Two-step by design: 'propose' designs the skill and explains it fully WITHOUT creating anything — always do this first and relay the full explanation before proceeding. Only call 'create' with the returned proposal_id after the user has seen the explanation and explicitly confirmed they want it built. Never call 'create' in the same turn as 'propose' without an explicit go-ahead in between.
keywords: you don't have a skill for

action.description: 'propose' designs and explains a skill without creating it. 'create' actually builds it — only call this after the user has seen and confirmed the proposal.

capability_description.description: Plain description of what the new skill should do. Required for action='propose'.

proposal_id.description: The proposal_id returned by a prior 'propose' call. Required for action='create'.
